Locally bundled tokenizer for AI-100 LLM Explorer

js-tiktoken 1.0.21: https://github.com/dqbd/tiktoken/tree/main/js
Vocabulary: cl100k_base, bundled from js-tiktoken/ranks/cl100k_base.
Includes base64-js (MIT). License texts are in this directory.
The ~1 MB bundle is loaded only when Chapter 2 Scene 1 is opened.
There are no runtime API or CDN requests for tokenization.

Rebuild from the repository root:
  npm ci --prefix tools/llm-tokenizer
  node tools/llm-tokenizer/build.cjs

Validate:
  node tools/llm-tokenizer/verify.cjs
  node --test tests/llm-tokens.test.cjs tests/llm-tokens-ui.test.cjs

The adapter deliberately uses the pinned js-tiktoken textMap byte entries:
decoding each token as a string would lose partial Unicode byte sequences.
The scene shows these entries as hexadecimal bytes, not replacement characters.
Special-token spellings typed by students are treated as ordinary text.
Word comparison uses whitespace-separated chunks, explicitly labeled in the UI.
